devices.description: List of block devices to protect (e.g. 'sda', 'hda'). Can be specified multiple times. Defaults to 'sda'.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity threshold. Higher values mean less sensitive to movement. Default is 15.

adaptive.description: Enable adaptive threshold (automatic increase when built-in keyboard/mouse are used). Corresponds to --adaptive.

force.description: Force unloading heads even if kernel thinks different (on pre ATA7 drives). Corresponds to --force.

force_rotational.description: Autodetect drives as rotational, even if kernel thinks they are not. Corresponds to --force-rotational.

background.description: Run the process in the background. Corresponds to --background.

dry_run.description: Don't actually park the drive. Corresponds to --dry-run.

poll_sysfs.description: Force use of sysfs interface to accelerometer. Corresponds to --poll-sysfs.

hardware_logic.description: Uses the hardware fall detection logic instead of the software one. Options --sensitivity and --adaptive have no effect in this mode. Corresponds to --hardware-logic.

software_logic.description: Uses the software fall detection logic even if the hardware one is available. Corresponds to --software-logic.

no_leds.description: Don't blink the LEDs when a shock is detected. Corresponds to --no-leds.

syslog.description: Log to syslog instead of stdout/stderr. Corresponds to --syslog.

pidfile.description: PID file location when running in background. Defaults to /var/run/hdapsd.pid if --pidfile is not specified.
